verdict.rationale: Speech is Cheap is a speech-to-text API, and a SaaS product of this kind could plausibly ship a built-in assistant, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows ways for external AI assistants and agents to call the service (a hosted MCP server and the x402 API). Those are adjacent integration surfaces, not an assistant built into the product that users delegate tasks to, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
